servinfo.title: Maintenance Recommended under Severe Driving Conditions

servinfosub.title: Except E02, E22 and E54 Model
servinfosub.ptxt: Follow this schedule if your vehicle is mainly operated under one or more of the following conditions.

item.ptxt: When most trips are less than 6 km (4 miles).
When most trips are less than 16 km (10 miles) and outside air temperature remains below freezing.
Idling and/or low-speed operation in stop-and-go traffic.
Operating in extremely cold weather and/or on salted roads.
Operating in rough and/or muddy areas.
Operating in dusty areas.
Repeated high speed drive or high engine revolutions.
Towing a trailer, if admitted.

servinfosub.ptxt: Schedule should also be followed if the vehicle is used for delivery service, police, taxi or other commercial applications.

item.ptxt: The intervals should be determined based on odometer readings or months, whichever comes first.
The following table shows the service schedule up to 90,000 km (54,000 miles). Beyond 90,000 km (54,000 miles), perform the same maintenance services at the same intervals shown in the table.

Class 2: K12M engine
Class 3: K12D engine

item.ptxt: “R”: Replace or change
“I”: Inspect, clean, adjust, lubricate or replace it if necessary
*1: If SUZUKI super long life coolant (coolant color: Blue) is replaced with the other coolant, follow schedule for SUZUKI long life coolant (coolant color: Green).
*2: Inspect or replace more frequently if the vehicle is used under dusty conditions.
*3: Inspect or replace it if necessary if vehicle is driven with high speed or high engine revolutions.
*4: Clean more frequently if the air flow from the air conditioner decreases.
